summary: R.U.S.E. entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: R.U.S.E.

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current Windows PC Definitive Edition capture

primary.why: R.U.S.E. has returned to Steam as a Definitive Edition including the DLC, making the current Windows release the best archive route instead of relying on old delisted media.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Steam Definitive Edition. Record build, included DLC, campaign mission, difficulty, skirmish/multiplayer state, Ubisoft/online service behavior, resolution/settings, and whether PS3/Xbox 360 versions were compared.

secondary.why: The current PC Definitive Edition is the complete capture route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record that the reissued Definitive Edition route was used and document any online/multiplayer service limitations.
